escalations.title: Handlebars.js 4.7.8 — CVSS 9.8 — 8 CVEs in test tooling
escalations.scope: test tooling only — no runtime usage in Source/
escalations.recommendation: Upgrade ts-jest and jest to force handlebars >= 4.7.9. Run: cd Source/Backend && npm upgrade --save-dev ts-jest jest

p1_findings.title: /api/search route not implemented — 5 tests failing
p1_findings.description: FR-dependency-search has a full test suite but no route file exists and it is not registered in app.ts. Every test hits 404.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and register app.use('/api', searchRouter) in app.ts

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind spot — 6/7 plans always falsely fail
p2_findings.description: Enforcer only scans Source/. Six plans target portal/ or platform/ code producing 15-34 false failures per run, desensitising developers.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to accept scan dirs from inspector.config.yml. Add portal/ and platform/ to scan list. Solo session required.

p2_findings.title: All 9 portal backend routes bypass service layer
p2_findings.description: Every route imports getDb and runs raw SQL in the request handler. Worst offenders: featureRequests.ts (17 DB calls), bugs.ts (16 DB calls), cycles.ts (11 DB calls).
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract SQL into service modules; route handlers call service only.

p2_findings.title: Source/ routes bypass service layer (3 route files)
p2_findings.description: workItems.ts, workflow.ts, and intake.ts all import workItemStore directly. intake.ts has no service at all.
p2_findings.recommendation: Introduce workItemService.ts and migrate route business logic there.

p2_findings.title: FR-TMP-001 (risk classification) implemented but missing Verifies comment
p2_findings.description: riskLevel logic fully implemented at lines 739-775 but has no // Verifies: FR-TMP-001 comment.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-TMP-001 at line 739. Solo session fix.

p2_findings.title: Brace-expansion <1.1.13 — zero-step sequences cause infinite loop / memory exhaustion
p2_findings.description: Zero-step sequences ({a..}) cause infinite loops and memory exhaustion. Fixable via jest/ts-jest upgrade.
p2_findings.recommendation: Upgrade ts-jest and jest: cd Source/Backend && npm upgrade --save-dev ts-jest jest

p2_findings.title: Vite 5.4.0 — path traversal in .map file handling (dev-time)
p2_findings.description: Dev-time vulnerability; allows reading arbitrary files during development via .map file handling.
p2_findings.recommendation: Upgrade vite to latest 5.x or 6.x patch: cd Source/Frontend && npm upgrade --save-dev vite

p3_findings.title: Duplicate test files — stale root-level vs canonical pages/ versions
p3_findings.description: Two stale root-level test files with wrong import paths run alongside canonical tests/pages/ versions.
p3_findings.recommendation: Delete root-level duplicates after confirming no unique test cases.

p3_findings.title: 113 console.log calls in platform/orchestrator/lib/workflow-engine.js
p3_findings.description: Architecture rule: use project logger abstraction, never console.log. No logger abstraction in platform/.
p3_findings.recommendation: Add logger abstraction to platform/orchestrator/; replace 113 console.log calls. Solo session only.

p3_findings.title: 2 unexplained eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressions
p3_findings.recommendation: Add explanatory comment or fix the dependency array.

p3_findings.title: E2E playwright config missing Verifies: FR-TMP-003
PostCSS <8.5.10 — unescaped </style> → XSS
p3_findings.description: Low risk if no dynamic CSS generation. Upgrade when next touching build tooling.
p3_findings.recommendation: Upgrade postcss when next touching build tooling.

p3_findings.title: esbuild <=0.24.2 — dev server CORS bypass
p3_findings.description: Dev environment only; no production impact.
p3_findings.recommendation: Upgrade esbuild when next touching build tooling.

p3_findings.title: Major version lag: React 18, React Router 6, Express 4, Pino 8
p3_findings.recommendation: Plan major version upgrades in a dedicated sprint.

p4_findings.title: Plans/dependency-linking/requirements.md references wrong paths
p4_findings.description: References portal/ paths but implementation is in Source/.
p4_findings.recommendation: Update plan doc to reference correct Source/ paths.

p4_findings.title: Portal missing FR-dependency-seed (no seed.ts) and blocked_by in type definitions
p4_findings.description: No seed.ts for FR-dependency-seed. blocked_by field absent from UpdateBugInput and UpdateFeatureRequestInput.
p4_findings.recommendation: Investigate and implement missing portal/ features per spec.
